title: Ballon d’Or 2026 Rankings Reveal As It Happened: Where Mbappe, Yamal, Kane Finished
subtitle: SI
paragraphs: By Toby Cudworth, Amanda Langell2:01 PM EDTThe 2026 Ballon d’Or is an open race.  / Pressefoto Ulmer\ullstein bild/Getty ImagesKylian Mbappé, Lamine Yamal and Harry Kane all have the dream of becoming a Ballon d’Or winner. For one of them, that dream is surely about to become a reality. The superstar trio have been regarded as the overwhelming favorites ever since the 30-player shortlist was confirmed, having enjoyed tremendous years for club and country, but only one was able to walk out of London as the winner.

Kane took home the ultimate prize in soccer after claiming a domestic treble with Bayern Munich and leading England to a third-place finish at the 2026 World Cup. Mbappé had to settle for a runners-up finish, while Yamal ranked third.

Alexia Putellas, meanwhile, won a record-equaling third Ballon d’Or Féminin, snatching the award from her former Barcelona teammate Aitana Bonmatí, who after three years of domination could not defend her crown after injury ravaged her 2025–26 campaign.
